headline: Hertz Shares Plunge as Car Rental Firm Warns of Low Cash
summary: Hertz Global Holdings shares plummeted after the car rental company warned that it expects to end the year with less cash and borrowing capacity than previously anticipated.
why: Liquidity warnings and cash burn projections directly threaten debt servicing capabilities and equity valuations for distressed consumer service companies.
